question: m15
q: Which of Sydney's commercial centres has the busiest Fridays relative to midweek right now, and which the quietest?

transcript.answer:
**Chatswood has the busiest Fridays relative to midweek, and North Sydney the quietest.** These are the latest figures, for September 2026.

| Centre | Friday ÷ Tue–Thu, Sep 2026 |
|---|---|
| **Chatswood** (busiest) | 1.03 |
| Strathfield | 1.00 |
| Parramatta | 0.812 |
| Sydney CBD | 0.783 |
| Macquarie Park | 0.770 |
| **North Sydney** (quietest) | 0.741 |

Chatswood is the only centre where Friday evening tap-ons match or exceed midweek (1.0 means no Friday gap). Its ratio has also risen the most this year, from 0.90 in January 2026 to 1.03 in September.

The measure counts Opal tap-ons from 3pm to 7pm, so it reflects people leaving work. The latest month is September 2026, the most recent release available.
